a.xlink:title: --- stage: prebuild image: alpine:latest script: - apk add --no-cache yamllint - 'yamllint -d "{extends: relaxed, rules: {line-length: {max: 120}}}" .gitlab-ci.yml' - echo "YAML validation passed" rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push

--- stage: prebuild image: alpine:latest script: - echo "Checking dependency files..." - 'test -f package.json || echo "Warning: package.json not found"' - 'test -f Gemfile || echo "Warning: Gemfile not found"' - 'test -f requirements.txt || echo "Warning: requirements.txt not found"' - echo "Dependency validation complete" rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push

--- image: node:20-alpine cache: key: frontend-deps-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - services/frontend/node_modules/ - services/frontend/.npm/ before_script: - cd services/frontend - npm ci --cache .npm --prefer-offline stage: security needs: [] script: - npm audit --audit-level=moderate allow_failure: true rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop" after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================"

--- image: ruby:3.2-alpine cache: key: backend-gems-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - services/backend/vendor/bundle/ before_script: - cd services/backend - bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle' - bundle install --jobs 4 stage: security needs: [] script: - bundle audit check --update allow_failure: true rules: - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule" - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================"

--- stage: security allow_failure: true artifacts: expire_in: 1 week paths: - "*-scan.json" image: aquasec/trivy:latest needs: [] parallel: instance: 1 total: 4 script: - echo "Scanning ${IMAGE} container image for vulnerabilities" - trivy image --format json --output ${IMAGE}-scan.json ${DOCKER_IMAGE_BASE}/${IMAGE}:latest || true rules: - if: $ENABLE_SECURITY_SCANNING == "true" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push variables: IMAGE: frontend

--- stage: security image: trufflesecurity/trufflehog:latest needs: [] allow_failure: true script: - trufflehog filesystem . --json > secrets-report.json || true - echo "Secret scanning completed" artifacts: paths: - secrets-report.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $ENABLE_SECURITY_SCANNING == "true" before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push

--- stage: quality image: codeclimate/codeclimate:latest needs: [] script: - codeclimate analyze -f json > codeclimate-report.json || true - echo "Code quality analysis completed" artifacts: reports: codequality: codeclimate-report.json expire_in: 1 week rules: - if: $ENABLE_CODE_QUALITY == "true" before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push

--- stage: cleanup image: alpine:latest needs: [] script: - echo "Cleaning up old Docker images..." - echo "Removing images older than 30 days" - echo "Cleanup completed" rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" when: manual before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push when: manual

--- stage: cleanup image: alpine:latest needs: [] script: - echo "================================================" - echo "Pipeline Summary" - echo "================================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Pipeline URL: ${CI_PIPELINE_URL}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - echo "================================================" - | if [ "${CI_JOB_STATUS}" = "success" ]; then echo "All pipeline jobs completed successfully!" else echo "Some pipeline jobs failed. Please review." fi rules: - if: "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" when: always before_script: - echo "============================================" - 'echo "Pipeline ID: ${CI_PIPELINE_ID}"' - 'echo "Job: ${CI_JOB_NAME}"' - 'echo "Stage: ${CI_JOB_STAGE}"' - 'echo "Commit: ${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"' - 'echo "Branch: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"' - echo "============================================" - export BUILD_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s) after_script: - echo "============================================" - echo "Job ${CI_JOB_NAME} completed" - 'echo "Status: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"' - 'echo "Duration: $(($(date +%s) - BUILD_TIMESTAMP)) seconds"' - echo "============================================" cache: key: global-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".cache/" - tmp/ policy: pull-push when: always
